item.title: AI in Gaming: How the NPC Becomes Human
item.description: SO, WHAT ARE NPCs?If you are into gaming, you definitely know what an NPC is. If you are tech-savvy and not into gaming, you can stumble upon NPC and its related content with a desultory web browsing. An NPC, short for non-Player Character, is a character in a game that is not controlled by humans. Though the NPCs are programmed by humans, they add life to the game and even pose as opposing characters to us in the game. This article will explore the basics of how AI is used and where it is used.
